notes.title: Indie Game Sim v1.3.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/a4ea19209ccce8126f499c83db23400e5d11f51b.png[/img]

[b]So, did you happen to read [url=http://www.gamasutra.com/blogs/MattHackett/20170213/291327/Making_an_Indie_Game_About_Indie_Game_Making.php]this sob story[/url] today? No? That's a shocker! Don't bother because it's a waste of your time. SUCH PATHETIC DRIBBLE!

Somehow, this ridiculous developer is back for more punishment, and has updated this garbage game INDIE GAME SIM -- sigh -- again. Not that anyone cares, but today there are new "static" spikes that can be placed anywhere, and a second "staggered interval rock" to fit with the other interval rock.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/ba776b8b8f1477934225852ab129e16575b79549.gif[/img]

Also BIG SURPRISE but nobody could figure out how to scroll the editor when first making a bigger game. Now the big obvious arrows should help you figure it out ... but you'll probably still be lost.

I suppose tomorrow's the only day you might actually PLAY this game, as it's Valentine's Day and NOBODY LOVES YOU bahahaaa[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/b5fe0de121ec7fe64d4c4e6f189864cc20cb9b7c.png[/img]

notes.title: Indie Game Sim v1.2.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/dba1712d591785be928f580081c1be0ab1769d44.png[/img]

[b]Yes yes, it's me again. SIGH! Today I'm in a BAD MOOD because -- for some reason -- this stupid game INDIE GAME SIM has been updated again.

Today we've got dumb changes including a bug fix that should have been spotted ages ago, and more information in market analytics.

I can't imagine WHY but some of you have been asking for sensitive jumps. There's now an item you can buy that gives your characters a deeper jump mechanic. Tap to hop, hold to leap. It's just there for you creators, shoved into the store -- what a LAZY DEVELOPER!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/e7deca42aeda4fbfba11eeb16478f9772ce361ff.gif[/img]

Hopefully this will be the LAST update to such a MEDIOCRE game. Steam only has so much room for nonsense and this game is wasting everyone's time.

Now go get that $60 AAA you've been wanting, probably now on SALE for $8. bahahaa[/b]

notes.title: Indie Game Sim v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26791535/6a651a007c24b2ae08691e0be7eb1112456cc55f.png[/img]

[b]Oh, hello. It's me again! We have met, right?

Doubtful, not that it matters ...

INDIE GAME SIM is obviously beyond help, what a MEDIOCRE game! But for some reason there is an UPDATE today, with the following changes:

* Add changelog scene
* Terminal scene to dump data to dev
* Improve game-rating algorithm. (100% isn't so easy anymore, is it?!)
* Add light to copycat
* Add another secret

Not that anyone will notice. Enjoy playing some BETTER game! bahaha[/b]
